c: add to the meat at mixing
Dissolve starter in cold, non-chlorinated water 20 min before use; add with the cure.
Grind meat and fat at −2 to 0 °C (partly frozen) for clean particle definition; mix until tacky (bind), meat below 2 °C.
Rinse salted casings inside and out; soak in lukewarm water 1 h.
Stuff firmly without air pockets; tie; prick with a sterile pricker; weigh and tag each piece (batch, date, start weight).
Spray salami evenly with mould solution.
Ferment 22–24 °C, 90% RH, 24–48 h until pH ≤ 5.3 (meter; log).
Dry at 12–15 °C, 75–85% RH; weigh weekly; target 30–35% loss.
Fault check: hard dry ring = humidity too low; green/black mould or slime = discard and sanitise.
